critique.evidence: The headline and training-fold caveat establish the core red-vs-blue claim, and the 4% initial to 0% final chart supports it. However, “leave zero survivors” conflicts at a glance with “25 mutation candidates remain,” “19 emergent,” and the “Surviving mutations” list. The intended next action is also ambiguous between “Enter Red Mode,” “Review fresh-row regression,” and “Show 19 additional survivors”; Enter Red Mode is not visible on the narrow mobile capture. Dense jargon and very small chart/annotation text further weaken standalone comprehension, especially on mobile.
critique.fix: Rephrase the claim as “reduce attack success to zero while retaining mutations for holdout testing,” then designate one consistent primary CTA—ideally “Run fresh-row regression”—and keep it prominent across all viewports. Demote secondary actions and enlarge the mobile chart labels and explanatory copy.
